nodes.label: T477's analysis in the session notes is WRONG twice over - use the task's own description and instrument first. The cwd row is only ATTACHED when show_cwd is true at build time; fixing it properly means the indent wrapper carries the visibility, or a 4px gap appears under every pathless pane.
A variant crosses as a NAME, never as a grid-ui enum. Adding Serialize/Deserialize to ButtonVariant in heca-grid-ui was asked for and refused - the crate boundary leaking the wrong way.
The app does NOT need needs_layout wiring: layout_layers already re-lays-out every visible layer every frame with no dirty check. The showcase does need it.
Decide where a fix belongs BEFORE writing the first line, not as a check before reporting. Grep for the count first and state it in the report.

The five file splits stay DEFERRED until P097(F003) is finished. They carve up app/registry.rs, showcase.rs, scroll_region.rs, heca-view/src/lib.rs and the multi-job files — several of which P097 is actively rewriting. A split landing mid-migration produces a diff nobody can review.

T491 is more than a showcase tidy-up: the showcase is what AGENTS § 1 tells every developer to copy from, and it currently demonstrates hand-rolling a row that exists as a component. Until it is fixed, treat the showcase as a place to see a widget run, not as authority on how to compose one.
The refused-pick message is a bottom-bar line, not a toast — Antonio rejected the toast as too intrusive for a key that could not act.
A nested identity owns its own hint letter: the offer walk stops at a subtree holding a different key, so a workspace's letter is never drawn on a pane inside it.
Whoever counts pick candidates decides what a candidate is — 'never letter the pane you are on' moved from the letter layer into candidate collection.
The physical-key repair for a rewritten character fires on the symptom, not on which modifier is held, so a layout that produced a real character keeps its own answer.
REJECTED: the terminal next_wake deadline for the cwd, built on a wrong diagnosis and reverted — on macOS the directory comes from OSC 7, not the foreground sample.
REJECTED: attributing the ~130 ms cwd latency to the per-frame scans; measured, it sits around request_redraw and the frame being served.
The authoring API jumped the queue because P094's next tasks are new code that would otherwise be written in the spellings being deleted.
The app assigns what a keycap MEANS; the widget only places it.
KeyHint is only for a region that is not a widget you can put a builder on.
A widget says its own pick; KeyHint is only for a region that is not a widget you can put a builder on.
One walk for every picker, with the scope passed in — KeyHintGroup's private copy is deleted.
